From 192c344e7cd4e19a4260752604ba219ffa41deb1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2021 13:00:54 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] clk: renesas: rcar-gen3: Update Z clock rate formula in
 comments

The fixed divider in the calculation of the Z and Z2 clock rates was
generalized from a hardcoded value of two to a parameterized value, but
the comments were not updated accordingly.

Fixes: 20cc05ba04a93f05 ("clk: renesas: rcar-gen3: Parameterise Z and Z2 clock fixed divisor")
Signed-off-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Acked-by: Stephen Boyd <sboyd@kernel.org>
Reviewed-by: Yoshihiro Shimoda <yoshihiro.shimoda.uh@renesas.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210326120100.1577596-2-geert+renesas@glider.be

diff --git a/drivers/clk/renesas/rcar-gen3-cpg.c b/drivers/clk/renesas/rcar-gen3-cpg.c
index caa0f9414e45..5edc85ab04b4 100644
--- a/drivers/clk/renesas/rcar-gen3-cpg.c
+++ b/drivers/clk/renesas/rcar-gen3-cpg.c
@@ -38,7 +38,8 @@
  * Traits of this clock:
  * prepare - clk_prepare only ensures that parents are prepared
  * enable - clk_enable only ensures that parents are enabled
- * rate - rate is adjustable.  clk->rate = (parent->rate * mult / 32 ) / 2
+ * rate - rate is adjustable.
+ *        clk->rate = (parent->rate * mult / 32 ) / fixed_div
  * parent - fixed parent.  No clk_set_parent support
  */
 #define CPG_FRQCRB			0x00000004
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/clk/renesas/rcar-gen3-cpg.c`**
   - The comment regarding the calculation of the clock rate has been updated. 
   - The original line:
     ```c
     * rate - rate is adjustable.  clk->rate = (parent->rate * mult / 32 ) / 2
     ```
     has been changed to:
     ```c
     * rate - rate is adjustable.
     *        clk->rate = (parent->rate * mult / 32 ) / fixed_div
     ```
   - This change generalizes the fixed divisor from a hardcoded value of two to a parameterized value (`fixed_div`).

### Relationships

- The modification in the `rcar-gen3-cpg.c` file is a direct response to a previous change made in commit `20cc05ba04a93f05`, which parameterized the Z and Z2 clock fixed divisor. The update ensures that the comments accurately reflect the new implementation, thereby improving code clarity and maintainability. The patch is linked to the fix of the earlier commit by addressing the oversight in documentation following the code change.

the comments were not updated accordingly.

Signed-off-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Acked-by: Stephen Boyd <sboyd@kernel.org>
Reviewed-by: Yoshihiro Shimoda <yoshihiro.shimoda.uh@renesas.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210326120100.1577596-2-geert+renesas@glider.be

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug was the failure to update the comments in the code after the fixed divider for the Z and Z2 clock rates was changed from a hardcoded value of two to a parameterized value. This discrepancy between the code and the comments could lead to confusion for developers maintaining the code, as the comments no longer accurately described the clock rate calculation.
